member.name: P:Syncfusion.EJ2.Gantt.Gantt.AddDialogFields
member.summary: Defines the tabs and fields to be displayed in the add dialog. If not specified, the fields will be derived from the `taskSettings` and `columns` values.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.EJ2.Gantt.Gantt.AllowExcelExport
member.summary: If `allowExcelExport` set to true, then it will allow the user to export Gantt chart to Excel and CSV file.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.EJ2.Gantt.Gantt.AllowFiltering
member.summary: Enables or disables filtering functionality in the Gantt chart.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.EJ2.Gantt.Gantt.AllowKeyboard
member.summary: Enables or disables keyboard interactions in the Gantt chart.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.EJ2.Gantt.Gantt.AllowParentDependency
member.summary: Specifies whether to allow dependency connection support for parent records.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.EJ2.Gantt.Gantt.AllowPdfExport
member.summary: If `allowPdfExport` set to true, then it will allow the user to export Gantt chart to PDF file.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.EJ2.Gantt.Gantt.AllowReordering
member.summary: If `allowReordering` is set to true, Gantt chart columns can be reordered. Reordering can be done by drag and drop of a particular column from one index to another index.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.EJ2.Gantt.Gantt.AllowResizing
member.summary: Enables column resizing in the Gantt chart when `allowResizing` is set to true. When enabled, users can adjust the width of columns by dragging the column borders.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.EJ2.Gantt.Gantt.AllowRowDragAndDrop
member.summary: If `allowRowDragAndDrop` set to true, then it will allow the user to perform row drag and drop action in Gantt chart.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.EJ2.Gantt.Gantt.AllowSelection
member.summary: If `allowSelection` is set to true, it enables row selection in the Gantt chart, and the selected rows are highlighted.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.EJ2.Gantt.Gantt.AllowSorting
member.summary: If `allowSorting` is set to true, it enables sorting of Gantt chart tasks when the column header is clicked.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.EJ2.Gantt.Gantt.AllowTaskbarDragAndDrop
member.summary: Defines whether to enable or disable the taskbar drag and drop action in the Gantt chart.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.EJ2.Gantt.Gantt.AllowTaskbarOverlap
member.summary: Specifies whether taskbars can overlap in the Gantt chart. To enable overlapping behavior, use this property along with `enableMultiTaskbar`.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.EJ2.Gantt.Gantt.AllowUnscheduledTasks
member.summary: Enables or disables the rendering of unscheduled tasks in the Gantt chart. When `allowUnscheduledTasks` set to true, unscheduled tasks will be displayed in the chart.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.EJ2.Gantt.Gantt.AutoCalculateDateScheduling
member.summary: Specifies whether to auto calculate the start and end dates based on factors such as working time, holidays, weekends, and task dependencies.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.EJ2.Gantt.Gantt.AutoFocusTasks
member.summary: Enables or disables automatic focusing on the taskbar when a task is clicked.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.EJ2.Gantt.Gantt.BaselineColor
member.summary: Specifies the color of the baseline bar in the Gantt chart.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.EJ2.Gantt.Gantt.CalendarSettings
member.summary: Defines the calendar configuration for the project, including working times, holidays, and task-specific calendars.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.EJ2.Gantt.Gantt.CollapseAllParentTasks
member.summary: Defines whether all root tasks should be rendered in a collapsed state. When `collapseAllParentTasks` set to true, all parent tasks will be collapsed by default.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.EJ2.Gantt.Gantt.ColumnMenuItems
member.summary:
`columnMenuItems` defines both built-in and custom menu items for the Gantt chart column menu.
The available built-in items are, `ColumnChooser` - To show/hide the TreeGrid columns. `SortAscending` - Sort the current column in ascending order. `SortDescending` - Sort the current column in descending order. `AutoFitAll` - Auto fit the size of all columns. `AutoFit` - Auto fit the size of the current column. `Filter` - Displays filter options based on the `filterSettings` property.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.EJ2.Gantt.Gantt.Columns
member.summary: Defines the collection of columns displayed in the Gantt chart grid. If the `columns` declaration is empty, the columns are automatically populated based on the `taskSettings` values.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.EJ2.Gantt.Gantt.ConnectorLineBackground
member.summary: Defines the background color of the dependency lines (connector lines) in the Gantt chart. You can set the color as a valid CSS color string (e.g., "red", "#FF5733", "rgb(255,0,0)").

member.name: P:Syncfusion.EJ2.Gantt.Gantt.ConnectorLineWidth
member.summary: Defines the width of the dependency lines in the Gantt chart. The value should be a positive integer, representing the thickness of the lines.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.EJ2.Gantt.Gantt.ContextMenuItems
member.summary: Defines the built-in and custom items that appear in the context menu of the Gantt chart. You can use this property to control the content and functionality of the right-click context menu.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.EJ2.Gantt.Gantt.DataSource
member.summary: Defines the data source for the Gantt chart, which is used to render rows and tasks. The `dataSource` can be an array of JavaScript objects, an instance of `DataManager`, or a single object. The array of objects should contain the task data with properties such as `TaskID`, `TaskName`, `StartDate`, `EndDate`, etc. This allows dynamic binding of tasks and their relationships (e.g., dependencies, subtasks, progress) to the Gantt chart.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.EJ2.Gantt.Gantt.DateFormat
member.summary: Specifies the date format for displaying dates in the Gantt chart, including in tooltips and grid cells. By default, the format is determined based on the current culture/locale settings.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.EJ2.Gantt.Gantt.DayWorkingTime
member.summary: Defines the customized working time for the project to ensure accurate task scheduling, and works only when the timeline is configured with topTier.unit as 'Day' and bottomTier.unit as 'Hour' or when `timelineViewMode` is set to 'Hour' or 'Day'.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.EJ2.Gantt.Gantt.DisableHtmlEncode
member.summary: If `disableHtmlEncode` is set to `true`, the Gantt component disables HTML entity encoding across the Gantt content, allowing custom HTML elements to be rendered.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.EJ2.Gantt.Gantt.DurationUnit
member.summary: `durationUnit` Specifies the duration unit for each task. The available options are: `day`: Sets the duration unit to day. `hour`: Sets the duration unit to hour. `minute`: Sets the duration unit to minute.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.EJ2.Gantt.Gantt.EditDialogFields
member.summary: Defines the tabs and fields to be displayed in the edit dialog. If not specified, the fields will be derived from the `taskSettings` and `columns` values.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.EJ2.Gantt.Gantt.EditSettings
member.summary: Configures the edit settings for the Gantt chart, such as enabling or disabling task modifications.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.EJ2.Gantt.Gantt.EmptyRecordTemplate
member.summary: Defines a custom template to display when the Gantt chart has no records.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.EJ2.Gantt.Gantt.EnableAdaptiveUI
member.summary: If `enableAdaptiveUI` is set to true, the pop-up UI becomes adaptive to smaller screens, enabling better usability for filtering and other features.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.EJ2.Gantt.Gantt.EnableAutoWbsUpdate
member.summary: Enables the automatic update of WBS codes when performing actions like sorting, filtering, row drag and drop, and other grid operations that change the task order or hierarchy. When set to true, the Gantt component will refresh and regenerate the WBS codes dynamically after such actions to ensure the codes remain in sync with the current task structure.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.EJ2.Gantt.Gantt.EnableContextMenu
member.summary: If `enableContextMenu` is set to true, enables the context menu in the Gantt chart. The context menu provides additional actions that can be accessed by right-clicking on Gantt chart elements

member.name: P:Syncfusion.EJ2.Gantt.Gantt.EnableCriticalPath
member.summary: Enables the highlighting of critical tasks in the Gantt Chart that directly affect the project's end date. When enabled, tasks that are critical to the project timeline will be visually distinguished by colours.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.EJ2.Gantt.Gantt.EnableHover
member.summary: If `enableHover` is set to true, it enables hover in the Gantt chart and highlights the rows, chart rows, header cells and timeline cells.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.EJ2.Gantt.Gantt.EnableHtmlSanitizer
member.summary: Specifies whether to display or remove the untrusted HTML values in the TreeGrid component. If `enableHtmlSanitizer` set to true, any potentially harmful strings and scripts are sanitized before rendering.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.EJ2.Gantt.Gantt.EnableImmutableMode
member.summary: If `enableImmutableMode` is set to true, the Gantt Chart will reuse existing rows from previous results instead of performing a full refresh when Gantt actions are executed.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.EJ2.Gantt.Gantt.EnableMultiTaskbar
member.summary: Enables the rendering of child taskbars on the parent row when it is in a collapsed state in the Gantt chart.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.EJ2.Gantt.Gantt.EnablePersistence
member.summary: Enable or disable persisting component's state between page reloads.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.EJ2.Gantt.Gantt.EnablePredecessorValidation
member.summary: If `enablePredecessorValidation` is set to true, enables validation for predecessor links in the Gantt chart.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.EJ2.Gantt.Gantt.EnableRtl
member.summary: Enable or disable rendering component in right to left direction.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.EJ2.Gantt.Gantt.EnableTimelineVirtualization
member.summary: Enables better performance for projects with a large time span by initially rendering only the visible timeline cells when `enableVirtualization` is enabled. Subsequent cells are loaded on horizontal scrolling.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.EJ2.Gantt.Gantt.EnableUndoRedo
member.summary: Enables or disables the undo and redo functionality in the Gantt chart.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.EJ2.Gantt.Gantt.EnableVirtualMaskRow
member.summary: Specifies whether to display a shimmer effect during scrolling in the virtual scrolling feature when `enableVirtualization` is enabled. If disabled, a spinner is shown instead of the shimmer effect.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.EJ2.Gantt.Gantt.EnableVirtualization
member.summary: If `enableVirtualization` is set to true, the Gantt chart will render only the rows visible within the viewport. and load subsequent rows as the user scrolls vertically. This improves performance when dealing with large datasets.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.EJ2.Gantt.Gantt.EnableWBS
member.summary: Enables Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) functionality in the Gantt Chart. When set to true, the Gantt Chart automatically generates WBS codes based on the task hierarchy. A dedicated WBS Code column will be shown to represent the task structure. Additionally, if task dependencies (predecessors) are mapped in the data source, a WBS Predecessor column will also be displayed to reflect dependency information using WBS codes.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.EJ2.Gantt.Gantt.EventMarkers
member.summary: Defines the events and milestones along the project timeline. These event markers indicate significant events or milestones throughout the project's duration.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.EJ2.Gantt.Gantt.FilterSettings
member.summary: Configures the filter settings for the Gantt chart, enabling users to filter tasks based on specific columns or criteria. The `filterSettings` property allows customization of filter behavior, such as which columns to filter and the filter type.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.EJ2.Gantt.Gantt.FrozenColumns
member.summary: Specifies the number of columns that should remain visible and fixed on the left side of the Gantt during horizontal scrolling. This feature ensures key columns, such as identifiers, stay visible while users scroll through data.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.EJ2.Gantt.Gantt.GridLines
member.summary: Configures the grid lines displayed in the TreeGrid and Gantt chart. The `gridLines` property allows customization of the type of grid lines to be shown, either horizontal, vertical, both or none.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.EJ2.Gantt.Gantt.Height
member.summary: Defines the height of the Gantt component container. The `height` property can be set to a specific value (in pixels or percentage) or set to 'auto' for automatic height adjustment based on content.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.EJ2.Gantt.Gantt.HighlightWeekends
member.summary: If `highlightWeekends` is set to true, it highlights all weekend days in the week-day timeline mode. This makes weekends visually distinct in the timeline view.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.EJ2.Gantt.Gantt.Holidays
member.summary: Defines holidays within the project timeline, allowing you to mark specific dates as holidays. This helps in accounting for non-working days in scheduling and task planning.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.EJ2.Gantt.Gantt.IncludeWeekend
member.summary: Defines whether weekend days should be considered as working days in the Gantt chart. When `includeWeekend` set to true, weekends (Saturday and Sunday) are treated as regular working days.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.EJ2.Gantt.Gantt.LabelSettings
member.summary: Configures the labels displayed on the right, left, and inside the taskbars in the Gantt chart.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.EJ2.Gantt.Gantt.LoadChildOnDemand
member.summary: Gets or sets whether to load child records on demand in remote data binding. When `loadChildOnDemand` set to true, child records are loaded only when expanded, and parent records are rendered in a collapsed state initially.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.EJ2.Gantt.Gantt.LoadingIndicator
member.summary: Specifies the type of loading indicator to display during scrolling action in the virtual scrolling feature when `enableVirtualization` is enabled.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.EJ2.Gantt.Gantt.Locale
member.summary: Overrides the global culture and localization value for this component. Default global culture is 'en-US'.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.EJ2.Gantt.Gantt.MilestoneTemplate
member.summary: Defines a custom template for rendering milestone tasks in the Gantt chart. This template allows you to customize the appearance of milestone tasks.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.EJ2.Gantt.Gantt.ParentTaskbarTemplate
member.summary: Defines a custom template for rendering parent task bars in the Gantt chart. This template allows you to customize the appearance of parent task bars.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.EJ2.Gantt.Gantt.ProjectEndDate
member.summary: Defines the end date of the project. If the `projectEndDate` is not set, it will be automatically calculated based on the data source. The date can be provided as a `Date` object or a string in a valid date format.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.EJ2.Gantt.Gantt.ProjectStartDate
member.summary: Defines the start date of the project. If the `projectStartDate` is not set, it will be automatically calculated based on the data source. The date can be provided as a `Date` object or a string in a valid date format.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.EJ2.Gantt.Gantt.Query
member.summary: Defines an external [`Query`](https://ej2.syncfusion.com/documentation/api/data/query) that will be executed in conjunction with data processing to filter, sort the data. This allows for advanced data manipulation before binding the data to the Gantt chart.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.EJ2.Gantt.Gantt.ReadOnly
member.summary: If `readOnly` is set to true, the Gantt chart becomes read-only, meaning tasks and other elements cannot be edited. This setting disables all editing features, including task updates, dependency management, and any editing acions.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.EJ2.Gantt.Gantt.RenderBaseline
member.summary: If `renderBaseline` is set to `true`, baselines will be rendered for tasks in the Gantt chart. Baselines provide a visual reference to track the planned vs. actual progress of tasks.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.EJ2.Gantt.Gantt.ResourceFields
member.summary: Defines the mapping properties to extract resource values, such as `id`, `name`, `unit`, and `group` from the resource collection in the Gantt chart. This helps to map data from a custom resource collection to the appropriate fields for resource allocation.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.EJ2.Gantt.Gantt.ResourceIDMapping
member.summary: Defines the mapping property to retrieve the resource ID value from the resource collection. This is used to map the resource ID from the resource data to the Gantt chart for resource allocation.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.EJ2.Gantt.Gantt.ResourceNameMapping
member.summary: Defines the mapping property to retrieve the resource name value from the resource collection. This is used to map the resource name from the resource data to the Gantt chart for task allocation.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.EJ2.Gantt.Gantt.Resources
member.summary: Defines the collection of resources assigned to the project.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.EJ2.Gantt.Gantt.RowHeight
member.summary: Defines the height of grid and chart rows in the Gantt chart. This property sets the vertical space allocated for each task or row, allowing customization of row sizes.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.EJ2.Gantt.Gantt.SearchSettings
member.summary: Configures the search functionality within the Gantt chart.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.EJ2.Gantt.Gantt.SegmentData
member.summary: Defines the collection of segments assigned to tasks in the Gantt chart.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.EJ2.Gantt.Gantt.SelectedRowIndex
member.summary: The `selectedRowIndex` allows you to specify the index of the row to be selected at the time of initial rendering. It can also be used to get the currently selected row index after selection. A value of `-1` indicates no row is selected.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.EJ2.Gantt.Gantt.Timezone
member.summary: By default, task schedule dates are calculated with system time zone. If the Gantt chart is assigned with a specific time zone, then schedule dates are calculated based on the given time zone date value. This property function properly when the timeline displays hours. To enable this, set `timelineViewMode` to 'Hour' or configure `topTier.unit` as 'Day' and `bottomTier.unit` as 'Hour'.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.EJ2.Gantt.Gantt.Toolbar
member.summary:
`toolbar` defines the toolbar items of the Gantt. It contains built-in and custom toolbar items. If an array value is assigned, it is considered as the list of built-in and custom toolbar items in the Gantt's toolbar.
The available built-in toolbar items are: Add: Adds a new record. Edit: Edits the selected task. Update: Updates the edited task. Delete: Deletes the selected task. Cancel: Cancels the edit state. Search: Searches tasks by the given key. ExpandAll: Expands all the task of Gantt. CollapseAll: Collapses all the task of Gantt. PrevTimeSpan: Extends timeline with one unit before the timeline start date. NextTimeSpan: Extends timeline with one unit after the timeline finish date. ZoomIn: ZoomIn the Gantt control. ZoomOut: ZoomOut the Gantt control. ZoomToFit: Display the all tasks within the viewable Gantt chart. ExcelExport: To export in Excel format. CsvExport : To export in CSV format. Indent: To indent a task to one level. Outdent: To outdent a task from one level.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.EJ2.FileManager.FileManagerUploadSettings.AutoUpload
member.summary: By default, the FileManager component initiates automatic upload when the files are added in upload queue. If you want to manipulate the files before uploading to server, disable the autoUpload property. The buttons "upload" and "clear" will be hided from file list when the autoUpload property is true.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.EJ2.FileManager.FileManagerUploadSettings.ChunkSize
member.summary: Specifies the chunk size to split the large file into chunks, and upload it to the server in a sequential order. If the chunk size property has value, the FileManager enables the chunk upload by default. It must be specified in bytes value.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.EJ2.FileManager.FileManagerUploadSettings.DirectoryUpload
member.summary: Specifies a Boolean value that indicates whether the folder (directory) can be browsed and uploaded in the FileManager component. This property allows to select or drop to upload the folders (directories) instead of files. When folder upload is enabled, all the folder contents including hierarchy folders and files are considered to upload. Folder (directory) upload is supported for the following file system providers, - Physical provider - NodeJS provider - Azure provider - Amazon S3 provider

member.name: P:Syncfusion.EJ2.FileManager.FileManagerUploadSettings.MaxFileSize

member.name: P:Syncfusion.EJ2.FileManager.FileManagerToolbarItem.Overflow

member.summary: Specifies where the button text will be displayed on popup mode of the Toolbar. member.name: P:Syncfusion.EJ2.FileManager.FileManagerToolbarItem.SuffixIcon

member.name: M:Syncfusion.EJ2.FileManager.FileManagerUploadSettingsBuilder.DirectoryUpload(System.Boolean)
member.summary: Specifies a Boolean value that indicates whether the folder (directory) can be browsed and uploaded in the FileManager component. This property allows to select or drop to upload the folders (directories) instead of files. When folder upload is enabled, all the folder contents including hierarchy folders and files are considered to upload. Folder (directory) upload is supported for the following file system providers, - Physical provider - NodeJS provider - Azure provider - Amazon S3 provider

member.summary: Specifies a Boolean value that indicates whether files are uploaded sequentially in the FileManager component. This property allows to select or drop to upload the files. When enabled, files are uploaded one at a time, reducing network load for large files.

When enabled, the File Manager will only load a subset of files and folders based on the size of the view port, with the rest being loaded dynamically as the user scrolls vertically through the list. member.name: P:Syncfusion.EJ2.InteractiveChat.ChatUI.LoadOnDemand
member.summary: Enables on-demand loading of messages, typically triggered as the user scrolls through the chat history. When set to `true`, older messages will load progressively, improving performance for large message histories by avoiding initial loading of all messages.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.EJ2.InteractiveChat.ChatUI.MentionTriggerChar
member.summary: Specifies the character that triggers the @mention suggestion popup in the chat input. The trigger character must be a single character, such as '@' or '#', and is case-sensitive in the input.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.EJ2.InteractiveChat.ChatUI.MentionUsers
member.summary: Specifies the list of users available for mention in the chat UI. This property defines an array of user objects that populate the @mention suggestion popup when the mention trigger character is typed. When typing the `mentionTriggerChar` (e.g., '@') followed by characters filters this list to show matching users.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.EJ2.InteractiveChat.ChatUI.MessageTemplate
member.summary: Specifies the template for rendering individual messages in the Chat UI component. This property can accept either a string or a function to customize the appearance of messages. The template context includes message and index.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.EJ2.InteractiveChat.ChatUI.MessageToolbarSettings
member.summary: Specifies the settings for the message toolbar in the Chat UI component. Configures the toolbar options associated with each message such as Reply, Forward, Copy, Pin, and Delete. If 'items' is not provided, default toolbar actions ['Copy', 'Reply', 'Pin', 'Delete'] will be rendered.

member.name: P:Syncfusion.EJ2.InteractiveChat.ChatUI.ShowHeader
